title: The Esperanza Algorithm for Maximum Independent Set
content: The maximum independent set problem asks for the largest set of pairwise non-adjacent vertices in an undirected graph. It is NP-hard to approximate within \( n^{1-\varepsilon} \) for every \( \varepsilon>0 \), and under the Unique Games Conjecture it is hard to approximate within \( O(\Delta/\log^2\Delta) \) on graphs of maximum degree \( \Delta \); the Khot--Regev form of the conjecture, for which a proof has been reported but not yet peer reviewed, also rules out a \( (2-\varepsilon) \)-approximation of Minimum Vertex Cover. We present version 0.1.6 of ESPERANZA, which takes the better of a dynamic minimum-degree (Caro--Wei) greedy set and the complement of the SALVADOR vertex cover, and improves it by three budgeted local searches: repair-and-grow restarts at the cover vertices and at a maximum-degree vertex, chained local restarts realising \( (k,k+1) \)-improvements, and an iterated \( (1,2) \)-swap search. We prove that it runs in \( O((n+m)\,\alpha_{\mathrm A}(n)) \) expected time for fixed budgets, with \( \alpha_{\mathrm A} \) the inverse Ackermann function. We prove that the output is a maximal independent set, that its complementary vertex cover has at most \( 2\tau-r \) vertices, where \( \tau \) is the minimum cover size and \( r \) the number of components with an edge, and that the ratio is at most \( (\Delta+2)/3 \) on graphs of maximum degree \( \Delta \). We prove the ratio \( 2\sqrt n \) on every graph with \( \Delta\le\sqrt n \) and on three further classes, and state it for all graphs as a conjecture, whose proof would imply \( \mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP} \). We also state the conjecture that the complementary cover has at most \( 2\tau-|M| \) vertices for the NetworkX minimum maximal matching \( M \); a proof would give a \( 3/2 \)-approximation for Minimum Vertex Cover and refute the Unique Games Conjecture unless \( \mathrm{P}=\mathrm{NP} \). In reproducible experiments the returned set is optimal on all \( 30\,000 \) graphs of a suite certified by an exact integer program; on \( 40 \) Khot--Regev YES instances with \( 640 \) to \( 2\,560 \) vertices the conjectured bound is certified on \( 38 \) and open on \( 2 \); and on \( 31 \) bounded-degree graphs the certified ratio is at most \( 1.0769 \) on the families with a planted independent set.
